notes.title: STILL GOING!
notes.notes:
Another update, just to let you know, we're still working.

It's going to be a [b]WHILE[/b], and I know that years on the internet are an eternity, but we're giving this new version the most amount of work we can to avoid what happened last time.

Thanks for sticking with us this far, and we hope the wait is worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41811749/4e3c96f232369189ca3e0f221c93c5017a06743a.png[/img]

Love and kisses,
Crab.

notes.title: Goblins cannot be forgotten, and they won't be.
notes.notes:
We are not full-time developers, and we're first timers for releasing on steam, and I need to put my thanks forward towards those who have given us the feedback we need to make the best decisions for our title.

We've got full-time jobs so it's hard for us to find the time to make big changes, but I assure you they are coming. We will make sure that your purchase was a good one, at least eventually.

Wanted to let you guys know we haven't abandoned it.

Love you guys,
~Crab

notes.title: Update 0.1.7.14
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Furnace (Our Biggest Enemy) [b]HOPEFULLY[/b] fixed
[*] Furnace UI updated
[*] Fixed orange tint on metal nodes
[*] Gigatrat can no longer be damaged before he is able to attack
[*] Removed waves on shoreline until a later date to help with performance
[*] Rat sounds are now linked to SFX volume
[*] Rats attack after being damaged
[*] Rat Feet stick to the ground :)
[*] Rats sprint when a target is found
[*] UI updates to tooltips
[*] Inventory Colour Changes
[*] Pump Shotgun sounds linked to SFX volume
[*] Pump Shotgun texture fixed on world model
[*] New particle effects when hitting trees
[*] Deleted unused assets
[*] Update to Gigatrat lever particle effect 
[*] Bounty/Bulletin Board Added to town square
[*] Furnace and Crafting Table Resized
[*] Options Menu Overhaul
[*] Added Keybinding Menu
[*] Added Sounds and Particle Effects to Magic Rats
[*] Player sprinting SFX fixed
[*] Amounts that can be gathered from individual nodes increased
[*] Tutorial Added
[/list]


Known Issues:
- Some systems struggling with performance
- Duplication Bugs



The best way to keep up to date with our development, and support us also, is via our Patreon:
[url=https://www.patreon.com/RiceCrab]RiceCrab Studios Patreon[/url]
Here you can vote in polls, and perhaps even get early access to playtesting builds.

I must say again, only do this if you can!

Thank you guys, and especially those who left all those kind reviews both positive and negative!
Love,
[b]Crab[/b]

notes.title: Goblin Town is Released!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's out![/h1]

Hello Goblins and Galblins, and of course all over types of creature.

Goblin Town has finally been [b]released[/b], and although it came a little after our intended date, it's out.

We're going to be working on this game for the Foreseeable future, and we're hoping that you guys will stick with us. Thanks so much for holding out, you guys are the best. 


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41811749/13a9d9905dcc72fd3562b9e86f14eb994fd7a4a4.png[/img]

[h2]What's to come:[/h2]
